title: Number of Households and Living Quarters
description: Number of households and living quarters in Malaysia from 1970 to 2024.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: households
fields.title: Number of Households
fields.description: [Numeric] The total number of households for the given year

fields.name: living_quarters
fields.title: Number of Living Quarters
fields.description: [Numeric] The total number of living quarters for the given year; note that this also includes empty dwellings.

methodology: Values for 1970, 1980, 1991, 2000, 2010 and 2020 are based on adjusted data from the Population Censuses conducted in those years. Values for all other years are intercensal mid-year population estimates. For a deeper understanding of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/population-technotes).
caveat: Values for breakdowns may be slightly different to totals when summed, due to rounding to one decimal place.
publication: OpenDOSM features a [dashboard on the population of Malaysia](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/population).
